integer_type_information.description: List of integer sizes used and amount of bits. Will be removed in the future.

distinct_login_versions_other_than_all.description: List of login versions that have messages, except for all.

login_version_opcodes.description: Map of login opcodes and message names.

prepared_objects.description: Is a structured representation of the object where fields that are inside if statements will be put inside the enumerators they are present in. This is used for example when wanting to represent conditionally present fields through e.g. discriminated unions or inheritance.

name.description: Name inside the object. Search through the original object to get type and other information.

enumerators.description: If this is present the field contains other fields.

prepared_object.description: Represents a field in the object, and the fields for each enumerator if it's an enum/flag.

compressed.description: Object body consists of uint32 with decompressed size followed by compressed bytes of members.

non_network_type.description: Not sent in a network message but used in e.g. a DBC file or otherwise in the client.

used_in_update_mask.description: Object is used by UpdateMask type.

display.description: Pretty printed string of definer enumerator.

maximum_length.description: JSON Typedef does not support integers larger than unsigned 32 bit, so this is a string

valid_range.description: JSON Typedef does not support integers larger than unsigned 32 bit, so this is a string

file_info.description: File information about the original .wowm definition.

value.description: JSON Typedef does not support integers larger than unsigned 32 bit, so this is a string

oneOf.description: Login message sent by the client.
Login message sent by the server.
World message sent by either the server or the client.
World message sent by the client.
World message sent by the server.

anyOf.description: This is set if the field is ignored by the client or can only have a single value.
This is set if the variable is used as the size in an array variable.

used_in_if.description: This is set if the variable is as the definer in an if statement.

size.description: Amount of elements in the array. JSON Typedef does not support integers larger than unsigned 32 bit, so this is a string.

oneOf.description: Arrays that always have an exact amount of elements.
Arrays that have a variable amount of elements, determined by the value in a previous variable.
Arrays that have a variable amount of elements, determined by if there are still unread bytes remaining.
64-bit integer followed by a CString if the value isn't zero.

definer_type.description: Flag or enum. Flag means that more values can be active at the same time. Enum means that only a single can be active at the same time.

values.description: Enumerators that apply to this if statement.

original_type.description: Original type used in the if statement.

part_of_separate_if_statement.description: The same definer has multiple disconnected if statements in the same body. This is significant since it means that a definer can be more than just one enumerator.

is_else_if_flag.description: Is definer type flag and has else if statements. This is significant since from a normal flag since it means that some bits should not be able to be set at the same time.

This is used for example when wanting to represent conditionally present fields through e.g. discriminated unions or inheritance.
